name: IrishJobs.ie
notes: Largest Irish general job board. Supports keyword + location + sponsorship filters. High volume of mid-senior tech roles.

name: Jobs.ie
notes: Second-largest Irish board. Strong on graduate and mid-level tech roles. Mix of direct employer and recruiter postings.

name: RecruitIreland.com
notes: Long-established Irish job board. Decent coverage of permanent IT and security roles. Many roles routed via agency.

name: Headhunt.ie
notes: Niche Irish tech recruitment site. Curated mid-senior IT and security roles. Lower volume but better signal-to-noise.

name: JobsIreland.ie (DETE)
notes: Official DETE jobs portal. Includes public sector and employer-direct postings. Authoritative for permit-relevant roles.

name: Publicjobs.ie
notes: Irish public sector recruitment. Government cybersecurity and IT support roles via NCSC, OGCIO. Lengthy process but stable employment.

name: Talent.com Ireland
notes: Aggregator pulling from many sources. Useful for breadth across direct and recruiter postings.

name: Indeed Ireland
notes: Largest aggregator. Pre-filtered to show roles mentioning visa sponsorship explicitly. Refresh daily.

name: Indeed Ireland (AppSec)
notes: Indeed filtered for AppSec engineer roles in Dublin. Often shows CSEP-eligible positions.

name: Indeed Ireland (Pentest)
notes: Indeed filtered for penetration tester roles anywhere in Ireland. CSEP-eligible specialist roles.

name: LinkedIn Ireland (CSEP)
notes: LinkedIn filtered to last 7 days for fresh roles. Use 'Easy Apply' filter for fastest applications. Cross-check sponsorship via recruiter message.

name: LinkedIn Ireland (SOC)
filter_applied: SOC Analyst in Ireland, last 7 days
notes: L1/L2 SOC analyst openings refreshed weekly. Good fallback if CSEP-eligible AppSec roles are thin.

name: IT Jobs Watch Ireland
notes: Salary benchmarking + active role listings. Useful for verifying CSEP threshold matches advertised salary bands.

name: CPL Resources careers
notes: Largest Irish recruiter. Wide tech desk. Many roles unposted elsewhere — apply direct and follow up via dedicated recruiter.

name: Sigmar Recruitment
notes: Major Irish agency. Strong in FS sector — relevant for SOC and GRC. Sponsor-aware recruiters.

name: Morgan McKinley Ireland
notes: Professional staffing firm with strong FS tech division. Good for GRC, risk, and compliance roles.

name: Hays Ireland
notes: Global staffing giant, Dublin office. High volume of contract and perm tech roles.

name: Eolas Recruitment
notes: Irish-owned IT specialist firm. Active in mid-large Irish tech companies. Lower volume but better recruiter access.

name: The Journal Jobs
notes: Irish media outlet's job board. Includes graduate + entry-level roles often missed elsewhere.

name: Irish Times Jobs
notes: Mid-senior corporate roles. Strong representation of larger Irish and multinational employers.
